title: John Marrero's instruments, his wife, and self-teaching
summary: John played banjo, guitar and piano, taught himself under their father; his widow could tell more about him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught
